footnote_text: The reported securities represent restricted stock units ("RSUs"), each of which represents a contingent right to receive one share of Class A Common Stock. || The RSUs vest in substantially equal installments on each of the first three anniversaries of August 1, 2026, subject to the Reporting Person's continued employment through the applicable vesting date. || This amendment to the Form 4 filed on August 10, 2026 (the "Original Form 4") corrects the number of RSUs granted on August 6, 2026, which was inadvertently understated in the Original Form 4 due to a calculation error. The reported amount in this amendment correctly reflects the number of RSUs granted on August 6, 2026.
